draft.title: Hybrid texts
card: A genre or text type is a kind of text with familiar features, such as a diary, a recipe or a news report.
A hybrid text mixes two or more genres or text types in one work. A novel told through diary entries and emails is one example.
The mix creates new effects. A text may feel more real, show a character's private voice, or surprise the reader.
Each part keeps features of its own type. Emails have a subject line and sign-off, and diary entries have dates.
draft.remember: A hybrid text blends genres or text types to create effects a single type could not.

a.q: Which of these is a hybrid text?
opts: A story told through text messages and news articles
A news article that reports on a local flood
A diary written only in dated entries
A recipe with a list of steps
a.why: The story mixes two text types, messages and articles, in one work. The other three each stay within a single text type.
a.clue: Look for the one that blends two kinds of text.

b.q: A fantasy novel includes maps, a character's letters and a page from a spell book. Why might the author use this mix?
opts: To make the invented world feel more real to readers
To replace the plot with a list of facts
To turn the novel into a news report
To avoid showing any character's voice
b.why: Maps, letters and spell pages feel like real objects from the world, so they add realism and variety. They do not replace the story, and letters actually show character voices.
b.clue: Think about how real documents make a world feel.

a.best: A story told through text messages and news articles

b.best: To make the invented world feel more real to readers

problems.detail: The remember line says the mix creates effects 'a single type could not'. The card only says the mix creates new effects that a text 'may' have. This is a stronger, absolute claim the card does not teach, and it is arguably false, since a single type such as a diary can also show a private voice.

check.summary: Both questions are sound and have a single clear answer. The remember line overstates the card by claiming hybrid effects are ones 'a single type could not' create, so soften it to match the card's 'new effects'.

a.q: Which of these is a hybrid text?
opts: A story told through text messages and news articles
A news article that reports on a flood in a country town
A diary written as a set of dated personal entries
A recipe with an ingredients list and numbered steps
a.why: The story mixes two text types, messages and articles, in one work. The diary may seem tempting, but it stays within one text type, as do the news article and the recipe.
a.clue: Look for the one that blends two kinds of text.

b.q: A fantasy novel includes maps, a character's letters and a page from a spell book. Why might the author use this mix?
opts: To make the invented world feel more real to readers
To replace the story's plot with a list of plain facts
To turn the whole novel into a factual news report
To keep every character's private thoughts hidden
b.why: Maps, letters and spell pages look like real objects from that world, so they can make it feel more real. Letters do the opposite of hiding thoughts: they can show a character's private voice.
b.clue: Think about how real documents make a world feel.
